name: Lost in Translation, Not in Confidence: Benchmarking and Calibrating Multilingual Decision Models
title: Lost in Translation, Not in Confidence: Benchmarking and Calibrating Multilingual Decision Models
summary: Decision models are language models fine-tuned to return a probability for each option of a typed query, which routers and guardrails threshold directly. They are built on multilingual bases but ranked almost entirely in English.
